cv.name: Erik Lundgren
cv.headline: Production Manager – Food Manufacturing | From professional kitchens to the factory floor
cv.summary: Production manager in food manufacturing who started out as a chef. Moved into industrial production in 2021, earned the IHK master craftsman qualification and now runs three ready-meal lines with 85 people.

experience.title: Production Manager
bullets: Responsible for three ready-meal lines, 85 employees in two shifts and output of 40 t per day
Raised OEE from 61% to 72% through changeover reduction and daily shop-floor meetings
Led the IFS Food v8 audit preparation; site kept Higher Level
Plan shifts, maintenance windows and capacity with planning in SAP PP

experience.title: Production Shift Supervisor
bullets: Led a night shift of 20 on two bread lines

experience.title: Sous Chef
bullets: Ran a kitchen team of eight, menu costing and HACCP documentation

education.degree: Certified Industrial Master – Food (Industriemeister Lebensmittel, IHK)
Upper secondary diploma, Restaurant and Food Programme

skills: Team leadership on the shop floor
